title: Survival on an Island
problemStatement: A person must survive for S days on an island. Food can only be purchased on certain days, and there is a daily purchase limit. Determine the minimum number of days on which food must be purchased to survive, or print -1 if survival is impossible.
input: • First line contains integers S, N, and M, where N is the maximum units purchasable per day and M is the daily food requirement.
output: Print the minimum number of purchase days, or -1 if impossible.
